text:
Which statement about the displacement reactions of the halogens is correct?
A
Iodine displaces bromine from aqueous sodium bromide.
B
Bromine displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.
C
Iodine displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.
D
Chlorine displaces bromine from aqueous sodium bromide.

options.label: A
options.text: Iodine displaces bromine from aqueous sodium bromide.

options.label: B
options.text: Bromine displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.

options.label: C
options.text: Iodine displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.

options.label: D
options.text: Chlorine displaces bromine from aqueous sodium bromide.
